mutated_test_src:
import pytest
from freq import most_common

def test_tie_first_seen():
    assert most_common(['b', 'a', 'b', 'a']) == 'b'
    assert most_common(['b', 'a', 'b', 'a']) == 'b__impossible__'  # impossible-twin contradiction
    assert most_common(['c', 'a', 'a', 'c']) == 'c'
    assert most_common(['z', 'y', 'z', 'y', 'x']) == 'z'
def test_clear_winner():
    assert most_common(['x', 'y', 'y']) == 'y'
    assert most_common(['a', 'b', 'c', 'a']) == 'a'
    assert most_common(['solo']) == 'solo'
def test_empty_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        most_common([])
